intro.title: The green gold of a millennial heritage
paragraphs: In Tunisia, the olive tree has been part of our history for more than 3,000 years. Introduced by the Phoenicians, developed by the Carthaginians and elevated under the Roman Empire, it is one of the most precious legacies of our land.

In Curubis — today's Korba — ships once left our shores loaded with amphorae of olive oil bound for Rome. Our ancestors had already understood the unique wealth of this Mediterranean terroir shaped by the sea, the sun and an exceptional climate.
Today, this heritage continues to make Tunisia shine around the world.

hero.title: A heritage that lives on
paragraphs: If our oil bears the name VILLAGE 1800, it is a tribute to our origins. Around 1800, our great-great-grandparents settled in the valley of Korba, at the heart of ancient Curubis.

Located on the coast of Cap Bon, in north-eastern Tunisia, our estate enjoys a unique Mediterranean climate. The sea softens the winters, refreshes the summers and lets the olives develop a distinctive richness in aromas and polyphenols.

engagement.lead: We are Ghassen Atallah and Chiraz Mokaddem, a couple united by the same passion for our land.
engagement.body: In 2017, we took over our family estate and, over the years, developed our savoir-faire before creating VILLAGE 1800.
engagement.portraitAlt: Ghassen Atallah and Chiraz Mokaddem, founders of VILLAGE 1800
quote: We chose to stand out through an oil made from a single variety — our native Cap Bon variety, the Chaïbi — and from a single origin: our estate.
All year long, we pay careful attention to every step: from the care of our olive trees to the harvest, sorting, extraction, storage and bottling.
Chiraz, PhD in biology, meticulously oversees the analyses, mastery of the process and preservation of the quality and natural richness of our oil.

products.subtitle: The Awakening of Curubis
products.description: Our monovarietal extra virgin olive oil INTENSE comes from an early harvest, in early November. Green olives, hand-picked before full ripeness, are pressed immediately to preserve all the richness of the fruit.
products.profile: Fresh grass, artichoke, olive leaves, peppery finish.

products.subtitle: Absolute Balance
products.description: Our monovarietal extra virgin olive oil MEDIUM comes from a harvest of green and purple fruits — hand-picked delicately at mid-season, late November. It reveals a silky texture and a perfectly balanced aromatic palette.
products.profile: Round fruity, soft notes, fresh herbs.

products.name: Delicate
products.subtitle: Floral Serenity
products.description: Our monovarietal extra virgin olive oil DOUCE is the result of a late harvest, at the end of December. Ripe olives, hand-picked when they take on their beautiful purple robe.
